items.stem: Under the Bill of Rights, no person shall be imprisoned for what?

options.text: Debt or non-payment of a poll tax

reveal.shortcut: Tie the fact to its section: Art. III, Sec. 20. No prison for debt.

why_wrong.o1: "Contempt of court" is not what this provision covers.
why_wrong.o2: "Theft" is not what this provision covers.
